limitations_and_boundaries: All fibroblasts were cultured and serially passaged on rigid matrices before transfer to hydrogels; thus the role of mechanical memory could not be assessed.
The study used immortalized fibroblast lines and adoptive transfer in immunocompromised mice, which may not fully recapitulate human disease.
YAP/TAZ knockdown was performed using siRNA, which may have off-target effects.
The study focused on lung fibroblasts; findings may not generalize to other fibrotic tissues.

research_questions.statement: What are the molecular mechanisms by which matrix stiffness drives fibroblast activation and fibrosis?

additional_provenance.text_excerpt: Here we identify yes-associated protein (YAP) and transcriptional coactivator with PDZ-binding motif (TAZ) as key matrix stiffness-regulated coordinators of fibroblast activation and matrix synthesis.

provenance.text_excerpt: We present several lines of evidence implicating YAP and TAZ as central regulators of pathological fibroblast activation in lung fibrosis.

claims.statement: YAP and TAZ are mechanoactivated by pathological matrix stiffness in lung fibroblasts and drive fibroblast activation and fibrosis.

provenance.text_excerpt: our study demonstrates that disease-derived IPF fibroblasts in culture are indistinguishable from normal lung-derived fibroblasts in their levels of YAP/TAZ expression and remain fully able to reverse YAP and TAZ localization and function when cultured on physiologically soft matrices.

claims.statement: IPF fibroblasts in culture are indistinguishable from normal lung-derived fibroblasts in YAP/TAZ expression and remain responsive to matrix stiffness.

provenance.text_excerpt: YAP/TAZ targeting in vivo may provide pleiotropic benefits by inhibiting matrix stiffness-dependent activation of fibroblasts while also blocking profibrotic biochemical signaling in areas of remodeled and stiffened matrix.

claims.statement: YAP/TAZ targeting may provide pleiotropic benefits by inhibiting matrix stiffness-dependent fibroblast activation and blocking profibrotic biochemical signaling in areas of stiffened matrix.

provenance.text_excerpt: Profibrotic effects of YAP and TAZ operate, in part, through their transcriptional target plasminogen activator inhibitor-1, which is regulated by matrix stiffness independent of transforming growth factor-β signaling.

claims.statement: Matrix stiffness effects on PAI-1 are independent of TGF-β signaling.

provenance.text_excerpt: our results demonstrate prominent TAZ nuclear localization in lung fibroblast activation and sufficiency of either YAP or TAZ to drive a fibrogenic response, suggesting overlapping or redundant function of YAP and TAZ in lung fibroblasts in the development of pulmonary fibrosis.

claims.statement: YAP and TAZ function redundantly in lung fibroblasts to drive fibrogenic responses.

methods.name: Cell culture on polyacrylamide hydrogels
methods.protocol_description: Human lung fibroblasts (IMR-90) were cultured on polyacrylamide hydrogels of defined stiffness (0.4 kPa, 6.4 kPa, 25.0 kPa) in DMEM with 1% FBS.

methods.name: Doxycycline-inducible Tet-On NIH3T3 cells
methods.protocol_description: NIH3T3 cells transduced with rtTA-Advanced, then with pLVX-Tight-Puro expressing 3xFLAG-tagged human TAZ-4SA or YAP-5SA; selected with G-418 and puromycin.

methods.name: Adoptive transfer
methods.protocol_description: NSG mice injected via tail vein with 1x10^6 YAP5SA- or TAZ4SA-expressing fibroblasts or control fibroblasts; given water or doxycycline (1 mg/ml) from day 0; euthanized after 14 days; lung collagen measured by hydroxyproline assay.

methods.name: Cell-derived matrix experiments
methods.protocol_description: Control or TAZ4SA-transduced NIH3T3 fibroblasts plated on gelatin-coated coverslips, fed with doxycycline (0, 1, or 100 ng/ml) every 48 h; decellularized at day 7; matrix protein quantified by BCA assay; naïve cell adhesion assay.

methods.name: siRNA knockdown
methods.protocol_description: Cells were seeded on hydrogels in 24-well plates with DMEM + 1% FBS without antibiotics overnight, then exposed to 25 nM of each targeting siRNA or nontargeting siRNA for 3 days. Knockdown confirmed by RT-PCR.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence
methods.protocol_description: Cells fixed in formalin, permeabilized with 0.5% Triton X-100, blocked with 10% normal goat serum, incubated with primary antibodies (anti-YAP, anti-TAZ, anti-vinculin, anti-procollagen I) at 1:500, then secondary Alexa Fluor antibodies at 1:500.

methods.name: Soluble collagen assay
methods.protocol_description: Cell culture media collected 72 h after transfection, collagen concentration measured using Sircol Soluble Collagen Assay, normalized to cell number by CyQUANT assay.

methods.name: Apoptosis assay
methods.protocol_description: Apoptosis assessed using ApoONE Caspase 3/7 Activity Assay; ratio calculated by dividing ApoONE signal by CyQuant signal.

methods.name: PAI-1 ELISA
methods.protocol_description: Cell culture media analyzed for PAI-1 using Human PAI-1 Quantikine ELISA Kit; concentrations normalized to cell number.

methods.name: Plasmin activity assay
methods.protocol_description: Plasmin activity measured using SPECTROZYME PL chromogenic substrate; absorbance at 405 nm.

methods.name: Traction force microscopy
methods.protocol_description: Polyacrylamide substrates with shear moduli 0.4 and 6.4 kPa prepared with fluorescent microspheres; bead displacement fields measured and traction computed using Fourier Transform Traction Microscopy.

methods.name: Quantitative PCR
methods.protocol_description: RNA isolated from cells on eight replicate stiffness wells, reverse transcribed, qPCR with SYBR green, normalized to GAPDH.
